questions.prompt: A 2 Ω resistor is in series with two 4 Ω resistors in parallel. What is the total resistance?
Give two reasons why household appliances are connected in parallel rather than in series.
questions.modelAnswer: In parallel every appliance gets the full mains voltage (230 V), so each works at its rated power. Each appliance can be switched on and off independently, and if one fails the others keep working. In series the voltage would be shared, appliances with different resistances would get wrong voltages, and one switch or fault would turn everything off.
